That commit is the plugin kit for Opus 2 public beta 3.2 (core 2.13); it is still the upstream head as of 2026-11-03.
Unmodified, except that these are left out:
  tools/re/          reverse-engineering helpers (not needed by this plugin)
  examples/          the kit's example plugins
  tools/toolchain/   the Blackfin compiler build script: the compiler is shared infrastructure, built once and kept
                     outside every project (docs/INSTALL.md), never inside a project repository
